note: Curated allowlist of SNCF Intercités de Nuit corridors, mirroring the nine Back-on-Track rows they are meant to replace. GTFS does not flag sleeper service, so the adapter needs to be told which routes carry it. `routes` is what scripts/lib/gtfs.mjs matches on (endpoint pairs, accent- and token-insensitive); `trainNumbers` is the operator's own numbering for the same nine corridors, used by scripts/probe-sncf.mjs and by the adapter if the dry run shows endpoint pairs alone also match daytime TGV services on the same city pairs.
